minutes.headline: ZBA granted a special permit for a used-car lot at 40 Summer Street, capped at 30 cars, and approved a duplex change on Buttonwood Place.
minutes.summary: The board heard two special permit applications. The first was a new owner seeking to reopen a used-car dealership at 40 Summer Street. Earlier permits there had been revoked, and the board questioned her at length about ownership, titles and the former partners. The second modified an earlier lot-width permit at 18 Buttonwood Place so it covers a duplex, not a single-family home.

public_comment.topic: Said the Board of Selectmen process that brought this business back was a tangled mess. Believes the applicant is determined to untangle what her predecessors created.
Said he learned of the situation a couple of months ago. Thinks the applicant has good intentions and the focus to run the business properly.

votes.motion: Grant a special permit for a car dealership at 40 Summer Street for Maxi Auto Sales, initially 20 cars, hours Mon-Fri 9-7 and Sat 9-5, on condition of proof that the former partners are out. Amended to 30 cars.
Modify the pre-existing special permit at 18 Buttonwood Place from a single-family home to a duplex.

budget_items.what_was_said: Through the translator, the applicant said she invested money in the business, funded by a mortgage on her home.
The applicant said the dealership sold about 400 cars last year.

decisions.decision: The Summer Street permit was conditioned on the applicant giving the board secretary proof that the former partners are no longer involved, before the license issues.
The board settled on a limit of 30 cars for sale (the original motion said 20), with employee parking allowed behind. The applicant may return to ask for more.
Business hours for the car lot were set at 9 to 7 Monday through Friday and 9 to 5 on Saturday.

Conditions were read into the decision, including: cars at least 20 feet from Summer Street, no outdoor junk or parts storage, and vehicles kept inspected. The permit lapses if the business is sold or sublet and is subject to periodic review.

what_happened.line: The board granted a special permit for a used-car lot at 40 Summer Street, limited to 30 cars, though the count of the vote was not audible.
The permit depends on the applicant giving the board secretary proof that the former partners are no longer involved, before the license issues.
Hours were set at 9 to 7 Monday through Friday and 9 to 5 Saturday. Conditions include a 20-foot setback from Summer Street and no outdoor junk or parts storage.
The permit lapses if the business is sold or sublet and is subject to periodic review. The applicant may return to ask for more cars.
The board passed a modification of an earlier permit at 18 Buttonwood Place, from a single-family home to a duplex.

why_it_matters: A used-car dealership can reopen on Summer Street where earlier permits were revoked, and neighbors will now see a capped lot with set hours and conditions, subject to periodic review.
The Buttonwood Place change adds a second dwelling unit to a lot whose earlier permit covered a single-family home.
watch_next: Whether the applicant gives the board secretary proof that the former partners are out, which must come before the license issues.
Whether the applicant returns to ask for more than 30 cars, which the board said she may do.
